subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir thinks, 'We have not lost the guide.'
source_quote: Zalthir notices that Sarith is not under the rocks and thinks, “We have not lost the guide.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir thinks, 'We need the healer.'
source_quote: He sees Thorin reach for Grygum and thinks, “We need the healer.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir thinks, 'If I don’t get him out of there, he will die.'
source_quote: He looks at Daz, “If I don’t get him out of there, he will die.”

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is relieved to see that Grygum is alive.
source_quote: Stool is relieved to see that Grygum is alive.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido believes the divine plan said Sarith would rescue him.
source_quote: Buppido shouts, “The divine plan said you would rescue me, Sarith!”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir remembers the particular gait of one of the Drow soldiers, Nym.
source_quote: Zalthir remembers the particular gait of one of the Drow soldiers, Nym, and mutters, “It’s the Drow from Velkynvelve. These are their scouts.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir remembers the story of the monk Korrh Erann who was pursued by Drow in the Underdark.
source_quote: He remembers reading the story of one of the monks of his order who was trapped in the Underdark and pursued by Drow. The monk, Korrh Erann, had been part of a group pursued for days. Some of their group hoped that killing the scouts would slow the Drow down. Korrh insisted that this was a dangerous gamble and chose to run. He was the only survivor.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir shouts, 'We have to run!'
source_quote: Zalthir, remembering the story, shouts, “We have to run!”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz mutters, 'Good decision. Maybe, just maybe, our traveling companions will see our actions and choose to help.'
source_quote: Daz mutters, “Good decision. Maybe, just maybe, our traveling companions will see our actions and choose to help.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz thinks, 'We are being followed.'
source_quote: Daz thinks, “We are being followed.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz hears the careful footsteps of a drow scout, a sound he is very familiar with.
source_quote: He hears the careful footsteps of a drow scout, a sound he is very familiar with.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz whispers, 'I was taught to cover our tracks in the Underdark.'
source_quote: The dwarf whispers, “I was taught to cover our tracks in the Underdark.”

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith mutters, 'Overbriters that cannot fly are the easiest prey in the Underdark.'
source_quote: Sarith mutters, “Overbriters that cannot fly are the easiest prey in the Underdark.”

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith explains that the Underdark is not flat, tunnels twist and turn, and the system is constantly changing.
source_quote: He then explains, “The Underdark is not flat. And the tunnels don’t move in a straight line. They twist, and they turn. Worse, the tunnel system is constantly changing. And so an enemy can appear far away, only to appear in front of you. What’s important is that we move. And we hope no tunnel gives them a shortcut to find us.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum thinks, 'Like a Maze?'
source_quote: Grygum thinks, “Like a Maze?”

subject: Jim Jar
fact: Jim Jar mutters, 'I was going to make a bet that I was going to find food, and you guys weren’t. But the silent one,' and he points at Zalthir, 'wanted us to run. So nobody is going to find food.'
source_quote: Jim Jar mutters, “I was going to make a bet that I was going to find food, and you guys weren’t. But the silent one,” and he points at Zalthir,” wanted us to run. So nobody is going to find food.”

subject: Jim Jar
fact: Jim Jar mutters, 'Wanna bet?'
source_quote: He pauses, “Wanna bet?”

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar mutters that the Faerzress was just a light but now seems to be a poison.
source_quote: Shuushar mutters, “That was odd. It was the first time I had felt so strange. The Faerzress was just a light, but now it seems to be a poison.”

subject: Jim Jar
fact: Jim Jar mutters that the Faerzress has never affected a living thing and only prevents teleportation spells.
source_quote: Jim Jar mutters, “That’s what happens with Kuo-Toans, who think they aren’t mad. They are insane, but their madness seems reasonable. The Faerzress has never affected a living thing. Its only magical power is to prevent teleportation spells.”

subject: Sathir
fact: Sathir mutters, 'Yes, I saw that.'
source_quote: Sathir mutters, “Yes, I saw that.”

subject: Sathir
fact: Sathir is annoyed and says, 'I didn’t need your help. But it’s good that you can help.'
source_quote: He looks annoyed, “I didn’t need your help. But it’s good that you can help.”

subject: Sathir
fact: Sathir explains that they did well to put some distance but have no water and must go slow tomorrow.
source_quote: As the day ends, Sathir explains, “We did well to put some distance. But we have no water. And if we don’t find some soon, things will get unpleasant. Tomorrow, we must go slow. Eldeth, it’s up to you to hide us.”

subject: Sathir's path through the cave
fact: Sathir is about to give up on finding a path through the cave to the next tunnel.
source_quote: Sathir mutters about the need to find a path through the cave to the next tunnel and is about to give up when Grygum shouts, “Is this what you are looking for?”

subject: Stool's rapport spores
fact: Stool wonders if using his rapport spores was a good idea and believes it was.
source_quote: He asks everyone, “Was that a good idea? I think it was a good idea.” Before anyone can respond, he says, “I’m really glad you liked my good idea!”

subject: Nym
fact: Nym mutters, 'I told you it was the other tunnel.'
source_quote: As they leave, Nym mutters, “I told you it was the other tunnel.”

subject: Sathir
fact: Sathir whispers that Ilvara has found them and they must put distance between them or have someone cover their trail.
source_quote: Sathir whispers in their skulls, “Ilvara has found us and, worse, has caught up with us. We must put some distance between us and them. Or we can keep going slowly and have someone cover our trail.”
